name: sqlite-to-fast-sql
description: Migrates SQLite and SQL-style Capacitor storage (@capacitor-community/sqlite, cordova-sqlite-storage, @ionic/storage with a SQLite driver, TypeORM/Drizzle/Kysely capacitor drivers, and other bridge-based SQL plugins) to @capgo/capacitor-fast-sql. Use when replacing createConnection/open/query/run/executeSet calls, slow large result sets over the Capacitor bridge, adding SQLCipher encryption, keeping transactions and BLOBs, moving key-value data to KeyValueStore, preserving existing database file
author: Cap-go
